visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a muscular man wearing a black baseball cap eating a piece of marinated chicken. Yellow text overlays appear at the bottom. He has a satisfied expression, squinting his eyes. (2) The scene shifts to the man standing inside a convenience store (FamilyMart), holding a package of chicken. He gestures with his hand while speaking. Shelves of snacks are visible in the blurred background. (3) A quick zoom focuses on two packages of chicken held in the man's hands, showcasing the brand name and product packaging. (4) The man is seen back in the store, opening a package and taking a large bite. He looks directly at the camera with an enthusiastic expression. (5) An extreme close-up shows the chicken being sliced into neat pieces with a knife on a wooden cutting board, highlighting the texture and seasoning. (6) The man is shown shirtless in a bright indoor setting, eating a slice of chicken and licking his fingers, emphasizing the flavor. (7) Returning to the store, the man continues to speak to the camera, holding the product. Fast cuts show him in different parts of the aisle. (8) He is seen running down an urban alleyway shirtless, holding two packages of chicken. A South Korean flag graphic and promotional text are overlaid on the screen. (9) The final shot is a close-up of the chicken products displayed on a refrigerator shelf in the store with price tags.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A moist, percussive chewing sound starts the audio, followed immediately by an energetic male voice with a bright pitch and fast speech rate. Upbeat electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 beat starts at a moderate volume. (2) A sharp 'beep' sound from a convenience store register interrupts briefly. The speaker's tone remains highly enthusiastic. Background ambient room tone is very faint. (3) A series of 'whoosh' sound effects accompany the rapid visual transitions. The music maintains a constant high-energy tempo. (4) A rhythmic, sharp hitting sound of a knife on wood occurs three times, synchronized with the visual of slicing chicken. The voiceover continues seamlessly. (5) Another series of loud chewing and lip-smacking sounds (high spectral brightness) emphasizes the eating action. (6) Wind noise and a slight increase in ambient urban hum enter the mix as the speaker's voice becomes louder and more strained, indicating physical exertion while running. (7) The video ends with a digital 'ding' sound effect as the promotional pricing is displayed, and the BGM fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Experience -> Product Detail -> Emotional Benefit -> Promotion -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Kingrich Korean-flavored chicken breast available at FamilyMart. It uses a muscular influencer to associate the product with health and fitness while emphasizing its authentic flavor and convenience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct recommendation of the product, display of brand logo, and mention of exclusive retailer (FamilyMart).

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-energy editing and a fitness-oriented persona to market a convenience store food product to health-conscious young adults.
